title: FieldOps Pro Technician Configuration
description: Operator identity and UI preferences for a FieldOps Pro install. Secrets (API keys) are NOT stored here — they live in Windows Credential Manager.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema. Bump when the structure changes.

_comment.description: Human-readable note. Ignored by the toolkit at runtime.

name.description: Operator's full name as it should appear on reports.

email.description: Operator's contact email. Appears on incident reports.

employeeId.description: Internal employee identifier. May be empty.

team.description: Operator's team or department. May be empty.

region.description: Deployment region (free text — common values: EU, US, APAC).

locale.description: Default UI language. Must match a file in CONFIG/lang/<locale>.json.

brandColor.description: Accent colour used by the dashboard (CSS hex).

version.description: Version string written to reports. Free-form (e.g. '2.0', '2.1-beta').
